reviews.comment: While i don't know my grade for class yet, i can say this has been a very laid-back professor who's always in a great mood. There aren't many assignments in this class so exams weigh a lot however they aren't hard. They are blue book exams like most english courses. Other than that theres 1 weekly discussion and attendance.
reviews.ratingTags: Get ready to read--Caring--Graded by few things

reviews.comment: This is the best professor I've ever had. If you like English classes, take any class from him that you can. It doesn't matter if you look at the topic and think that it's not for you, or that you won't like the topic, because Dr. O'Sullivan makes ANYTHING and EVERYTHING fascinating. I was excited to show up to his lectures every day. Best EVER!!
